figures.question: Which actuator and contact arrangement should we develop?
figures.method: All selected-bank full-record metrics, including startup. Four54-case grids; copper-loss panels only use force-eligible soft-pad grids.

figures.question: How do soft pads influence our results?
figures.method: Analytic ridge/envelope and minmaxlower bound1.2*mS; theoretical geometry, not a simulated force recording. Same77mm footprint.

figures.question: How many ADC bits do we need?
figures.method: Largest full-record error across threecorners at each code spacing, same noise and timing. Not hardware ADC/ENOB proof.

figures.question: How fast must the amplifier, ADC and accelerometer be?
figures.method: Three-corner worst diagnostics. Range-ineligible peaks omitted and failures marked at0.6N only as categorical marker, not a force value. Physical-stop outcomes marked.

figures.question: What calibration accuracy matters most?
figures.method: Follow-up afterknown1%mass failure. Identifiedmass changes inertia/gravity/bodyestimation while acquisitiontare remainsnominal. No independent qualification or fullresidualbox.

figures.question: Do we need an accelerometer, and how quiet must it be?
figures.method: Normalizedinputnoise is not filteredRMS or manufacturernoiseguarantee; removal affects multiple controlleruses. Counts include force/physical/sensor/actuator/continuous-current screens.
